lines.text: Micah says he is like a gleaner in the vineyard who finds no cluster to eat.
Micah says the godly man has perished, and the people hunt one another with a net.
Both hands are skilled at evil, and the prince and the judge demand a sacrifice.
Micah says even the best of them is like a fig tree, and the day of visitation has come.
Micah says he will look to the LORD and wait, and his God will hear him.
